samples.summary: Lessons file names a function that doesn't exist under that name; the actual shared removal helper is `removeNodeStyle`, not `removeCellNodeStyle`.
samples.evidence: "Yorkie has no single-node removal, so `removeCellNodeStyle` drops to the index API and removes over `[pathToIndex(cell), +1)`" — but `packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts` defines this helper as `removeNodeStyle` (line 273), a generic function used for both block and cell attribute removal, not a cell-specific `removeCellNodeStyle`. The mechanism described (index-range removal covering only the opening tag) is accurate; only the function name is wrong.
